thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated packet loss and request errors observed from POP eu-west2 (edge-pop-63). Thresholds crossed: packet_loss > 10% and 5xx_rate spike. Paging slate: @sre-amy (primary), @eng-oncall-marc (backup). Link: https://incidents.internal/r/1979501234

sre-amy: picking up. seeing ~12-18% packet loss toward eu-west2 from multiple vantage points. 5xx tail latency up too. starting a quick-hit check: traceroutes, BGP view, CDN steering status.

sre-amy: traceroute from our health probes -> holes at ISP hop (AS-54001) around 198.51.100.0/24. consistent for last 10m.

netops-javier: confirming from BGP: intermittent withdraws for prefixes announced in eu-west2, flapping with neighbor AS 54001. Also seeing traffic steering policy for eu-west2 drifted to higher weight earlier today (recent config change).

platform-alex: @netops-javier do we have quick rollback for CDN steering policy? can we soft-shift traffic to eu-west1/eu-central?

netops-javier: yes. CDN control API supports gradual traffic steering. suggest soft-shift 30% -> 70% to other eu POPs as an emergency mitigation. also can ask AS peer to dampen flaps but that takes vendor coordination.

support-lina: getting customer reports about timeouts on streaming sessions and image load failures from EU storefronts. opening customer-facing blurb ready once impact numbers are stable.

eng-oncall-marc: I'm en route, ETA 3m. handing off if needed.

sre-amy: quick health numbers: error rate for europe frontend across global front doors = 8.9% increase in 5xx over baseline. median p50 latency unchanged, p95 spiking. subset of sessions show tcp retransmits.

netops-javier: proposing plan: 1) soft-steer 40% off eu-west2 -> eu-west1/eu-central 2) apply BGP community to suppress prepends from eu-west2 for external peers if available 3) contact ISP ops (AS-54001) to escalate.

platform-alex: executing soft-steer now via CDN API. command: 
``` 
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.cdn.internal/v1/steering/change \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west2","shift_pct":40,"targets":[{"pop":"eu-west1","pct":50},{"pop":"eu-central1","pct":50}],"mode":"gradual"}'
```

platform-alex: started. applying weighted change with 30s rollout batches. monitoring.

netops-javier: pinged ISP NOC (noc@isp54001.net). they replied: "we see asymmetry, investigating downstream MPLS edge. will confirm within 15m."

sre-amy: after initial shift: packet loss observed now falling from ~15% -> ~6% on overall requests. 5xx rate trending down but still above baseline.

support-lina: drafted customer note: "We're aware of partial service interruptions for some EU users impacting streaming and asset loads. We're mitigating by shifting traffic; updates in 30m." want approval before send.

customer-success-noah: go ahead and send with "degraded experience" language, avoid naming vendor. include workaround: retry or use region selector fallback in app if available.

eng-oncall-marc: taking over incident from @sre-amy at 2023-11-02T04:45Z (handoff). Amy pls drop any continuing checks to me.

sre-amy: handoff confirmed. I'll keep running packet captures for any residual issues.

netops-javier: additional telemetry: DNS steering logs show our DNS health checks to eu-west2 were briefly returning 502s causing steering controller to increase weight update frequency. rolling back the automated adjustment might help.

platform-alex: disabling auto-scaled steering adjustments for eu region for duration of incident. command: 
``` 
rwctl steering set-policy --region eu --auto-adjust=false --reason "incident 1979501234"
```

platform-alex: done. manual control now.

eng-oncall-marc: status update: traffic shifted ~40% away from eu-west2, net error rate down to +2.1% above baseline. still seeing occasional blips tied to specific ISP path. continuing monitoring.

support-lina: sent initial customer note to impacted workspace list at 04:58Z. included guidance and link to status page.

netops-javier: ISP confirmed a downstream MPLS edge misconfiguration. they applied a fix around 05:12Z; we see BGP sessions stabilize.

sre-amy: verifying: active probes show packet loss at POP eu-west2 dropping to <1%. p95 latency settling back to normal.

eng-oncall-marc: initiating traffic reintroduction. will gradually move 30% back to eu-west2 over 10 minutes.

platform-alex: command to reintroduce: 
``` 
curl -X POST https://api.cdn.internal/v1/steering/change -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"region":"eu-west2","shift_pct":-30,"targets":[],"mode":"gradual"}'
```

platform-alex: started reintroduce.

sre-amy: after reintroduce p95 stable, error rate back to baseline. final packetloss metrics <0.5% at eu-west2.

eng-oncall-marc: incident moving to resolved state at 05:35Z. root cause: upstream ISP edge misconfig + automated steering sensitivity that amplified the effect.

customer-success-noah: posting post-incident customer note and offering 1:1 calls for top enterprise customers that reported streaming failures.

support-lina: creating follow-up ticket for documentation and CS outreach. assigning to @customer-success-noah.

sre-amy: will collect all logs, attach PCAPs and steering controller history. postmortem draft requested — owners: netops-javier (network analysis) and platform-alex (steering control tuning).

eng-oncall-marc: thanks team. quick wins: 1) disable aggressive auto-steering during volatility 2) add a throttle on steering controller when loss >10% to avoid oscillation 3) practice playbook for pop evacuation. I'll create a playbook PR. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1979501234 status changed to RESOLVED by eng-oncall-marc. Duration: 00:50:11. Postmortem ticket: https://jira.internal/browse/INC-2121

sre-amy: good catch on the handoff everyone. leaving a short note in the incident log. :thumbsup:
